== Biography ==

The Dodo is a creature of Wonderland, notably present among the pool of animals and birds who gathered together after an unusual deluge. When the waterlogged party came ashore, the Dodo proved to be a creature of formal bearing and practical temperament. It speaks with measured solemnity, consulting the group on matters of consequence—though its elaborate vocabulary sometimes provokes confusion among its companions, who found its turns of phrase unnecessarily ornate.

The Dodo is perhaps most recognized for its ingenuity in addressing the problem of persistent dampness that plagued the drowned creatures. When simple methods failed to dry the assembly, the Dodo proposed an alternative remedy: the Caucus-race, a curious competition whose rules—or lack thereof—it undertook to organize. The Dodo marked out a race-course in a circle, dismissing concerns about its exact shape as irrelevant to the endeavor, and set all the party upon the course in various positions. It appears the Dodo's approach to solving problems is to demonstrate rather than merely explain, embodying a peculiar Wonderland logic of its own.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Alice]]''' — ally. The Dodo gestures toward Alice, suggesting some degree of partnership in the Caucus-race gathering.

'''[[Eaglet]]''' — acquaintance. The two appear acquainted, though the Eaglet's public mockery of the Dodo's elaborate speech introduces tension to their interaction.
